name: tplink-easy-smart-switch-mcp
description: Inspect and safely configure TP-Link and Mercury Easy Smart switches through a local MCP server and guided workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Safely inspect and configure Easy Smart switches.
interface.longDescription: Inspect switch, port, VLAN, PVID, trunk, MAC, and topology state on supported TP-Link and Mercury Easy Smart switches, then preview and apply guarded configuration changes.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my TP-Link switch and summarize its current status.
Review my switch VLAN and trunk configuration for problems.
Preview this switch configuration change and apply it safely.
